title: CAA Torrent Pipeline: decentralised archaeological data sharing proof of concept
description: Proof-of-concept Python workflow developed for the CAA 2026 paper on decentralised archaeological data sharing using peer-to-peer and BitTorrent technologies. The software validates dataset metadata, packages datasets into verifiable archives, generates SHA-256 manifests, creates torrent files and magnet links, and records structured metadata for decentralised distribution.
